crossRefs.note: The Philistines laid hold on him and put out his eyes; and they brought him down to Gaza and bound him with fetters of…
The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of Yahweh, was taken in their pits; of whom we said, under his shadow we will…
So the detachment, the commanding officer, and the officers of the Jews seized Jesus and bound him,
him, being delivered up by the determined counsel and foreknowledge of God, you have taken by the hand of lawless men…

parallels.note: Jesus said to him, “Friend, why are you here?” Then they came and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.

translations.web: They laid their hands on him, and seized him.
translations.bsb: Then the men seized Jesus and arrested Him.
translations.kjv: And they laid their hands on him, and took him.
translations.asv: And they laid hands on him, and took him.
